arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bergmann argued the one-year period has two possible start dates.
Mr. Feldman argued the government's interpretation limits relief further.
Justice Breyer asked why the government's view might be better.
Justice Souter asked why a district court decision should not give notice.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the start date for a one-year filing limit. The limit applies to federal prisoners seeking a second habeas review. The parties disagree on the triggering event for this deadline.
